faces.name: Clash of Elements
faces.oracleText: Choose target nonland permanent. Its owner may put it on top of their library. If they do, Clash of Elements deals 2 damage to them. If they didn't put the card on top of their library, they put it on the bottom.

faces.name: Clash of Realities
faces.oracleText:
All Spirits have "When this permanent enters, you may have it deal 3 damage to target non-Spirit creature."
Non-Spirit creatures have "When this creature enters, you may have it deal 3 damage to target Spirit creature."

faces.name: Clash of Titans
faces.oracleText: Target creature fights another target creature. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)

faces.name: Clash of Wills
faces.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {X}.

faces.name: Clash of the Eikons
faces.oracleText:
Choose one or more —
• Target creature you control fights target creature an opponent controls.
• Remove a lore counter from target Saga you control. (Removing lore counters doesn't cause chapter abilities to trigger.)
• Put a lore counter on target Saga you control.

faces.name: Class-4 Tactical Cube
faces.oracleText:
When this Spacecraft enters, create two 1/1 colorless Borg artifact creature tokens.
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 7+.)
7+ | Flying
Artifact creatures you control get +1/+1.

faces.name: Class-F Shuttlecraft
faces.oracleText:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 6+.)
6+ | Flying, vigilance

faces.name: Clash Me Outside
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, clash with each opponent. The winner creates an Omenpath enchantment token with "Sacrifice this enchantment: Choose one - Planeswalk; or chaos ensues. Activate only as a sorcery." (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)
Whenever chaos ensues, clash with each opponent. The winner may cast the card they revealed without paying its mana cost.
